name: kea-relay-wrangler

comments.arm64: wrangler pulls in `workerd`, which has no win-arm64 build. On Windows-on-ARM run `npm install --save-dev typescript @cloudflare/workers-types` instead: you get `npm run typecheck` but cannot `deploy` from that machine.
comments.test: The end-to-end conformance suite lives in ../relay (python test_protocol.py) and is the contract this relay must match.
